title: Vessel positions, northern Baltic (Digitraffic AIS)
description: The last AIS position of each vessel Fintraffic's network heard within a day, most minutes old, some hours: MMSI, speed in knots (102.3 means unknown) and course (360 means unknown). A snapshot every 5 minutes, not a moving track.
